resources.string: Show the time of another zone where the seconds normally are, with a three-letter name. A + or - after the name means it is already tomorrow or still yesterday there. After a battery change it comes back as soon as the phone connects.
%1$s. Three letters, A to Z. Leave empty and the name comes from the zone.
Connect to the watch again as soon as the phone\'s Bluetooth is switched back on, without opening the app.
The phone can draw a picture for you: your next calendar event. It is refreshed every 15 minutes while the watch is connected and replaces your own picture.
Your next event in the coming 7 days.
Allow Gadgetbridge to read your calendar in the Android settings.
